identity.summary: Separat innendørs ishall i Jordal idrettspark, brukt til blant annet trening, kunstløp, ishockey og publikumsskøyting.

coordinate.coordNote: Geometrisk senter av OSM way 33263069, eksplisitt navngitt «Jordal ungdomshallen» og tagget som egen ishall med Oslobygg KF som eier, anleggsreferanse 31177 og bygningsnummer 81040303. Punktet brukes som building-specific anker og skiller ungdomshallen fra Jordal Amfi til tross for delt besøksadresse.

identityEvidence: The map object is explicitly named Jordal ungdomshallen, a definite-form spelling variant of Jordal ungdomshall.
The object is separately tagged as an ice rink and ice-hockey building with its own Oslobygg owner, facility reference 31177 and building number 81040303.
Oslo municipality documents Jordal idrettspark as having two separate ice halls: Jordal Amfi and Jordal ungdomshall.
Oslo byleksikon identifies Jordal ungdomshall at Jordalgata 12, distinct from Jordal idrettshall at 12A.

discardedDiagnostics.reason: The first exact-name gate searched for «Jordal ungdomshall» and missed the actual named object because OSM uses the definite form «Jordal ungdomshallen».

Two defibrillator nodes explicitly named Jordal Ungdomshall fall inside an overlapping/stale polygon currently tagged as Jordal amfi. That containment result conflicts with the separately named youth-hall building object and is therefore not used as the canonical coordinate source.

duplicateGate.conclusion: Jordal ungdomshall is a distinct physical hall with its own named building object and must not reuse the Jordal Amfi marker.

historyGuardrails.yearHandling: Sources differ between 1988 and 1989. Use 1989 only as an opening/use-era anchor if a single year is technically required, and describe the construction period conservatively as 1988–89.
historyGuardrails.visitOsloScope: Treat VisitOSLO's Jordal skøytebane listing as the public-skating use of Jordal ungdomshall, not as a separate third ice venue.
